title: Websites for Contractors
seoTitle: Websites for Contractors From $50: Demo Sites and Pricing
description: Fast, mobile-first websites for painters, roofers, plumbers, landscapers and remodelers, from $50. See five live demo sites and fixed prices.
body:
If you run a painting, roofing, plumbing, landscaping or remodeling business, your website has one job: turn the homeowner who just found you into a phone call or a quote request. We build websites for exactly that, using the same approach behind this site's calculators: fast pages, clear answers and nothing in the way of the call button.
Chat on WhatsApp See pricing See demo sites
## Demo websites we built {#demos} Five complete one-page websites for made-up businesses, one for each kind of trade we build for most. Open any of them on your phone: that is where your customers will see yours. Each one can be the starting point for your site, with your name, colors, photos and services.

Extra pages: $15 each on any plan.

Domain: registered in your name, usually $10 to $15 a year paid to the registrar. We help you buy it if you do not have one.

Hosting: sites like these run on free hosting such as Cloudflare Pages or Netlify, set up in your own account.

Payment: half to start, the rest after you approve the preview, by card or bank transfer through a secure payment link.

## What every site includes - **Built for phones first,** with your number tappable on every screen and a quote button always in reach. - **Fast loading,** hand-coded with compressed images and no heavy page builder, so it opens quickly even on a weak signal. - **Your real work up front:** project photos, before and after shots and your Google reviews. - **A service area section** that matches your Google Business Profile. - **The technical basics done right:** HTTPS, page titles, descriptions, a sitemap and clean code. - **No lock-in:** you get the files, you own the domain, and you can move the site anywhere. ## How it works 1. **Message us** on WhatsApp at {{whatsapp}} or email {{email}}. Tell us your trade, your towns and which plan you are thinking about. 2. **Send your details.** Logo, photos of real jobs, your services and a few reviews. No logo yet? We set your name in a clean type style. 3. **We build, you review.** You get a preview link to check on your phone before anything goes live. 4. **Launch.** We connect your domain, switch on HTTPS and submit the sitemap to Google. 5. **After launch.** The site is yours. Small changes later are quick and priced up front. ## Questions contractors ask
Why is it this affordable?

We hand-code lightweight sites instead of paying for page builders, plugins and agency overhead, and we reuse proven layouts like the demos above. You pay for the work on your site, not for an office.

Do I have to pay every month?

No. The plan price is paid once. The only ongoing cost is your domain renewal, paid to your registrar. Hosting for sites like these can be free.

Can you make it look different from the demos?

Yes. The demos show the quality and the features. Your site gets your own colors, fonts, photos and wording, and we can mix sections from different demos.

I do not have good photos. Is that a problem?

Phone photos of real jobs work well, especially before and after shots. Until you have enough, we can use clean illustrations like the ones on the demos.

Do you work with businesses outside the US?

Yes. We build for home service businesses in the US, UK, Canada, Australia and Europe. Everything is handled by WhatsApp and email, in English.

What happens after I message you?

We reply with a few questions about your business and a fixed price for the plan that fits. Nothing starts until you agree to it.
